HostProblem.description: Bounded RFC 9457 failure with no secrets, raw content, or addresses.

info.description: Versioned provider-neutral Mail Edge wire contracts.
info.title: Mail Edge contracts

get.description: Stream the exact raw message under a short-lived tenant, subject, audience, and raw_download-operation grant. Redirects, ranges, and content encodings are rejected; single-use grants are atomically consumed and all grants are fenced and revocable.

parameters.description: MailEdgeRaw followed by the opaque grant token.
parameters.name: Authorization

parameters.description: Exact grant audience.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Signature-Audience

parameters.description: Exact grant subject.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Subject-Id

parameters.description: Grant-bound operation.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Operation

200.description: Constant-memory authenticated byte stream with Content-Length.

post.description: Verify the exact body digest, audience, operation, subject, timestamp, key id, and MAC before atomically consuming the nonce. Active and retiring keys may overlap during rotation. Reject expired, replayed, mismatched, unknown-key, redirected, oversized, or malformed requests without side effects. Return a bounded application/json response and echo X-Mail-Edge-Subject-Id.

parameters.description: Frozen protocol version.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Signature-Version

parameters.description: Frozen MAC algorithm.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Signature-Algorithm

parameters.description: Rotation key identifier selected before verification.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Key-Id

parameters.description: Exact configured receiving service audience.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Signature-Audience

parameters.description: Operation-bound durable workflow subject.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Subject-Id

parameters.description: Unique unpadded base64url nonce consumed by the replay store.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Nonce

parameters.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the exact HTTP body bytes.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Body-Sha256

parameters.description: Exact callback operation; cross-operation replay is forbidden.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Operation

parameters.description: RFC 3339 signing instant within the receiver's bounded skew.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Timestamp

parameters.description: Unpadded base64url HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical HostSignatureV1 domain and claims.
parameters.name: X-Mail-Edge-Signature

200.description: Durably authenticated result; the subject response header must exactly match.

post.x-mail-edge-replay-semantics: Nonce consumption is atomic after signature verification and before business side effects; duplicate nonces fail closed.
